subject: Update on your application - Software Engineer Intern at Acme Corp
snippet: Thank you for your interest... unfortunately we will not be moving forward...
body:
Hi Alex,

Thank you for taking the time to apply for the Software Engineer Intern position at Acme Corp and for chatting with our team.

After careful consideration, we have decided to move forward with other candidates whose experience more closely matches the needs of this role. Unfortunately, we will not be moving forward with your application at this time.

We really appreciate your interest in Acme Corp and encourage you to apply for future openings.

Best regards,
Acme Corp Talent Team

subject: We regret to inform you - Data Analyst at Globex
